sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: Use of Proceeds The aggregate net proceeds from the sale of the Notes, after deducting the respective underwriting discounts and related offering expenses and giving effect to the underwriters’ payment to us, will be approximately $      . We intend to use the aggregate net proceeds from the sale of the Notes (i) to repay our outstanding $1.0 billion variable rate term loan due March 9, 2024 (the “Term Loan”), (ii) to repay a portion of our outstanding commercial paper and (iii) for general corporate purposes. At December 19, 2023, the Term Loan had an average interest rate of approximately 6.16% per year. At December 19, 2023, we had approximately $3.6 billion of commercial paper outstanding with a weighted average interest rate of approximately 5.63% per year.
